title: centaurea cuneifolia var. sublanata
intro: Centaurea cuneifolia var. sublanata, commonly known as the prickly centaury, is a plant species in the dandelion family, characterized by its unique, spiny stems and leaves. The plant is used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in protecting the body from oxidative stress, reducing inflammation, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea cuneifolia var. sublanata include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestion, and exert a sedative effect on the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
